chunks: That it was He who destroyed the 'Ad of old,

key_terms.أَهْلَكَ: He destroyed, annihilated, or brought to ruin.
key_terms.الْأُولَى: The first, distinguishing this group of 'Ad from others or indicating their primordial status.
key_terms.عَادًا: The ancient tribe of 'Ad, known for their strength and architectural prowess, who were destroyed by God.

ai.seo_question: Who did God destroy in the Quran as a sign of His power?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Najm underscores the transient nature of worldly power, illustrating how the mighty tribe of 'Ad was eradicated due to their hubris and rejection of divine guidance. It serves as a profound historical precedent for the ultimate justice of Allah, reminding believers that material strength cannot shield against divine retribution when coupled with spiritual arrogance.
